messages.subject: Overlay points to a qplot()
parts:
How can I overlay "independent" point table over a plotted qplot(x, y,
group = g, data = d,fill = f, geom = "polygon")

messages.author: 5ec5102a43e29af7
messages.subject: Re: Overlay points to a qplot()
parts:
On Tue, Feb 09, 2010 at 08:05:40AM -0800, Paulo Eduardo Cardoso wrote:
> How can I overlay "independent" point table over a plotted qplot(x, y,
> group = g, data = d,fill = f, geom = "polygon")

library(ggplot2)
d1 = data.frame(x=1:10,y=c(1:5,5:1))
d2 = data.frame(x=10:1,y=1:10)
qplot(x, y, data = d1,geom = "polygon") +
geom_point(data=d2,aes(x,y),colour="red")


regards,
stefam
